seo.title: Best Vegan Restaurants in Antwerp (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover Antwerp's top vegan restaurants! From cozy cafes to gourmet dining and delicious street food, find your next plant-based meal in this vibrant Belgian city.

hero.subtitle: Antwerp, a city known for its fashion and diamonds, also boasts a surprisingly vibrant and growing vegan food scene. Whether you're craving plant-based burgers, exquisite Asian dishes, or healthy brunches, the city's innovative chefs and dedicated eateries ensure a delightful experience for every palate.

picks.name: Camion
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Camion is a pioneering vegan eatery in Antwerp, renowned for its creative plant-based burgers and street food. Housed in a charming, laid-back setting, it’s a favorite for both vegans and omnivores alike, offering hearty, satisfying meals that redefine comfort food without compromise. Their commitment to flavor and quality is evident in every bite.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Crispy Chick'n Burger' with a side of loaded fries.
picks.insiderTip: They also have a fantastic brunch menu on weekends, so consider booking ahead if you plan to visit then, as it gets very busy.
picks.redditQuote: "Honestly, Camion is a game-changer. I still dream about their 'Crispy Chick'n Burger', it's unbelievably good and the vibe there is just perfect. You wouldn't even know it's all vegan!"

picks.name: Loving Hut Antwerp
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Part of the international Loving Hut chain, this Antwerp outpost offers a delightful array of Asian-inspired vegan dishes. From mock meats that fool the most discerning palates to fresh noodle bowls and flavorful curries, it’s a reliable spot for a diverse and affordable plant-based meal. The atmosphere is casual and welcoming, perfect for a quick lunch or relaxed dinner.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Golden Crispy Duck' (mock duck) or any of their fresh spring rolls.
picks.insiderTip: They often have daily specials not listed on the main menu, so ask your server for recommendations.
picks.redditQuote: "Loving Hut Antwerp never disappoints. Their vegan 'duck' is shockingly good, and I always leave feeling full and happy. Great for a casual, tasty meal."

picks.name: Falafel Tof
picks.whyItMadeTheList: While not exclusively vegan, Falafel Tof is legendary in Antwerp for its exceptional, generously portioned falafel, which is entirely plant-based. This bustling spot offers authentic Middle Eastern flavors in a lively, no-frills setting. It’s perfect for a quick, delicious, and incredibly satisfying meal, served with a variety of fresh salads and sauces.
picks.whatToOrder: A classic 'Falafel Sandwich' with extra hummus and all the fixings.
picks.insiderTip: It’s a popular spot, especially during lunch hours, so be prepared for a short wait, but the fresh falafel is absolutely worth it.
picks.redditQuote: "If you're in Antwerp, you HAVE to go to Falafel Tof. It's the best falafel I've ever had, hands down. Super fresh, amazing sauces, and so cheap!"

picks.name: Moss
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Moss is a chic and airy cafe focusing on healthy, plant-forward dishes, making it a dream destination for brunch and lunch. While they offer some vegetarian options, their vegan selection is extensive and creatively presented, from vibrant smoothie bowls to hearty sandwiches. It’s an ideal spot for a leisurely meal in a stylish, plant-filled environment.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Vegan Pancakes' or the 'Kimchi Toast' (can be made vegan).
picks.insiderTip: They have excellent coffee and a range of unique lattes; try the 'Blue Matcha Latte' for something different.
picks.redditQuote: "Absolutely loved Moss! The interior is gorgeous, and their vegan brunch options are delicious and so beautifully presented. Perfect for a relaxed Sunday."

picks.name: Veganzu
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Veganzu brings a sophisticated twist to vegan dining with its fully plant-based sushi and Asian fusion menu. Located in the modern Nieuw Zuid district, this restaurant offers beautifully crafted rolls, flavorful poke bowls, and innovative starters. It's an excellent choice for a special occasion or when you're craving high-quality, creative vegan Japanese cuisine.
picks.insiderTip: Their cocktail menu is as creative as their food, with several unique plant-based concoctions that pair perfectly with the dishes.
picks.redditQuote: "Veganzu is a revelation! I never thought vegan sushi could be this good. The textures and flavors are incredible, and the presentation is art. A must-try."

picks.name: Lombardei
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Lombardei is a charming, fully vegan bakery and cafe nestled in the heart of Antwerp. It's a sweet escape offering an impressive selection of cakes, pastries, sandwiches, and warm drinks, all entirely plant-based. The cozy atmosphere makes it an ideal spot for a coffee break, a light lunch, or indulging in some delicious vegan treats.
picks.whatToOrder: Any of their freshly baked cinnamon rolls or the 'Croque Monsieur' (vegan version).
picks.insiderTip: Visit in the morning for the freshest selection of pastries, and don't forget to grab a loaf of their artisanal vegan bread to take home.
picks.redditQuote: "Lombardei is my happy place! Their vegan croissants are divine, and I can finally enjoy a proper 'croque' without worry. So many delicious options."

picks.name: Wild Project
picks.whyItMadeTheList: For those who love pizza, Wild Project offers an entirely plant-based menu that will delight. Located in the trendy Eilandje district, this spot crafts delicious sourdough pizzas with innovative vegan cheeses and toppings. The industrial-chic decor adds to the cool, relaxed vibe, making it a great place for a casual dinner with friends.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Funghi Tartufo' pizza or the 'Nduja' (vegan version for a spicy kick).
picks.insiderTip: They also have a good selection of natural wines and local craft beers that pair well with their pizzas.
picks.redditQuote: "Wild Project makes amazing vegan pizza. The crust is perfect, and their cheese doesn't taste like plastic, which is rare! Plus, the atmosphere is super chill."

picks.name: Plant B
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Plant B is a vibrant and modern vegan lunch bar that focuses on fresh, healthy, and flavorful dishes. Their menu features a rotating selection of colorful bowls, delicious wraps, and daily specials, all prepared with seasonal ingredients. It’s a perfect spot for a nutritious and quick lunch in a bright, friendly setting.
picks.whatToOrder: One of their customizable 'Buddha Bowls' or the 'Soup of the Day'.
picks.insiderTip: They often offer homemade vegan desserts and snacks at the counter that are perfect for a mid-afternoon treat.
picks.redditQuote: "Plant B is fantastic for a healthy lunch. Everything is so fresh and tasty, and I love how they change up the menu. Their bowls are so satisfying."

picks.name: The Vex
picks.whyItMadeTheList: The Vex is Antwerp's go-to spot for unapologetically indulgent vegan comfort food. Think juicy burgers, massive loaded fries, and delicious snacks, all made entirely from plants. The interior is modern and quirky, creating a fun and relaxed atmosphere perfect for satisfying those deep-fried cravings without the guilt.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Vex Burger' with a side of 'Loaded Fries' topped with vegan bacon bits.
picks.insiderTip: They have a great selection of local beers to wash down their hearty meals, perfect for a casual evening out.
picks.redditQuote: "If you're looking for proper vegan junk food, The Vex is it. Their loaded fries are insane, and the burgers hit all the right spots. My go-to for cheat days!"

picks.name: De Broers van Julienne
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Though primarily vegetarian, De Broers van Julienne has a long-standing reputation for its excellent and clearly marked vegan options, deeply rooted in seasonal Belgian produce. This cozy restaurant offers a daily changing menu, ensuring fresh and creative dishes that highlight vegetables. It's a wonderful choice for a more traditional dining experience with a plant-based focus.
picks.whatToOrder: Ask about the 'Vegan Daily Special' – it's always inventive and delicious.
picks.insiderTip: As the menu changes daily, checking their website or social media beforehand can give you a preview of the day's vegan offerings.
picks.redditQuote: "De Broers van Julienne is a classic. Always reliable for a fantastic vegetarian meal, and their vegan options are always thoughtful and delicious. Great for a nice dinner."

picks.name: Bar Botanique
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Bar Botanique is a charming, plant-filled cafe known for its relaxed atmosphere and excellent coffee, with a strong focus on vegan and vegetarian-friendly options. It’s an ideal spot for breakfast, brunch, or a light lunch, offering delicious toasts, bowls, and pastries in a beautifully decorated setting that feels like a green oasis.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Avocado Toast' (vegan version) or a fresh smoothie bowl.
picks.insiderTip: They often host workshops or events, so check their schedule if you're looking for more than just a meal.
picks.redditQuote: "Such a lovely place! Bar Botanique has a great vibe and their vegan breakfast is so tasty. Perfect for a lazy weekend morning with a good book."

picks.name: Basta Pasta Bar
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Basta Pasta Bar is a popular spot where you can customize your pasta dish, with several delicious vegan options available. Choose your pasta, sauce, and toppings to create a personalized meal. Their commitment to fresh ingredients and flavorful sauces ensures a satisfying Italian-inspired experience for plant-based diners in a lively, casual environment.
picks.whatToOrder: Create your own pasta dish with 'Penne', 'Arrabiata' sauce, and added vegan meatballs or grilled vegetables.
picks.insiderTip: They have gluten-free pasta options available, making it suitable for even more dietary needs.
picks.redditQuote: "Basta Pasta is great because you can build your own vegan pasta dish exactly how you like it. The arrabiata with vegan meatballs is my go-to, never fails."

faq.question: Is Antwerp a good city for vegans?
faq.answer: Yes, Antwerp has developed into a very vegan-friendly city over recent years. You'll find a growing number of fully vegan restaurants, specialized cafes, and eateries with extensive plant-based options across various cuisines. From casual street food to fine dining, the city caters well to vegan diets, reflecting a broader shift towards plant-based eating.

faq.question: What kind of vegan food can I expect in Antwerp?
faq.answer: Antwerp's vegan food scene is incredibly diverse. You can find plant-based versions of classic comfort foods like burgers and pizzas, healthy brunch spots with smoothie bowls and avocado toast, authentic Asian cuisine, and even traditional Belgian-inspired dishes adapted for vegans. Many places also offer delicious vegan baked goods and desserts.

faq.question: Are there vegan-friendly options in non-vegan restaurants in Antwerp?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Beyond dedicated vegan establishments, many mainstream restaurants, especially those focusing on modern European or international cuisine, are increasingly offering clearly marked vegan dishes. It's always a good idea to check their menus online or ask staff upon arrival, as chefs are often happy to accommodate dietary requests.

faq.question: What is the average cost of a vegan meal in Antwerp?
faq.answer: The cost of a vegan meal in Antwerp varies, similar to non-vegan options. A budget-friendly meal like falafel or a light lunch might range from €8-15 / $9-17 per person. Mid-range restaurants for dinner, like a vegan burger joint or an Asian eatery, typically cost €15-28 / $17-31. More upscale or specialized vegan dining experiences can range from €25-40+ / $28-44+ per person.

faq.question: Are there vegan-friendly supermarkets or stores in Antwerp?
faq.answer: Yes, major supermarket chains in Antwerp like Colruyt, Delhaize, and Albert Heijn all stock a wide range of vegan products, from plant-based milks and cheeses to meat alternatives and organic produce. Additionally, specialized health food stores or organic markets often have an even broader selection of unique vegan items.

faq.question: Is it easy to find vegan options when dining out with non-vegans in Antwerp?
faq.answer: Yes, it's generally easy to find restaurants that can cater to both vegans and non-vegans in Antwerp. Many establishments are aware of dietary needs and offer diverse menus. Opt for places with clear vegetarian/vegan markings or those known for their flexible menus to ensure everyone in your group has delicious options to choose from.

methodology: Our selection for the best vegan restaurants in Antwerp is based on extensive research, including local reviews, culinary blogs, and community recommendations. We prioritize establishments offering fully vegan menus or a diverse range of clearly marked, innovative vegan options, evaluating them on taste, atmosphere, service, and value for money to ensure a comprehensive guide.
